item.title: Adjusting the Time-To-Live (TTL) in DynamicDNS (os-ddclient) Configuration in OPNsense
item.description:
Update October 2026: Since os-ddclient 1.18, new installations use the native backend by default. It does not use ddclient.conf, so the script below only works with the ddclient backend (Services > Dynamic DNS > Settings > General settings > Backend). Since os-ddclient 1.26, the TTL can be set directly in the GUI for Gandi and GoDaddy.

Unfortunately, in OPNsense, it is not possible to set the TTL (Time to Live) for Dynamic DNS, which means DNS entries always have a TTL of 10800 seconds or 3 hours. This limitation undermines the purpose of Dynamic DNS, in my opinion.
